crossRefs.note: They came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they spoke to him at the door of the house,

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: They came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they spoke to him at the door of the house,
translations.bsb: So they approached Joseph’s steward and spoke to him at the entrance to the house.
translations.kjv: And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,
translations.asv: And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they spake unto him at the door of the house,
